title: Open Trestle Route Capability Declaration v1
description: Canonical interchange shape that binds an unresolved route reference to declared model capabilities. Validation does not prove registry membership, observed support, availability, eligibility, or provider truth.

model_capabilities.description: Trusted runtime validation must also enforce every semantic invariant documented by the referenced capability schema.

$comment: Resolvers must use a caller-supplied closed local registry. This schema does not authorize remote reference retrieval.
